basis: MACOM publicly established the decline by August 3, 2023, when it reported fiscal Q3 consolidated revenue of $148,522,000 against $172,259,000 a year earlier. The 95% threshold was $163,646,050. The strongest earlier candidate is May 4, but its $150,000,000 high end excluded OMMIC, which closed May 31. The February call yielded a numeric estimate of OMMIC’s then-current revenue run rate. Neither that estimate nor the May call supplied a ceiling on OMMIC’s contribution for the quarter ending June 30. Historical event coverage remains incomplete, so the earliest qualifying date is unresolved.

coverage.detail: February 2, preceding earnings release. The $166 million–$170 million outlook covered fiscal Q2 ending March 31. It supplied no June-quarter revenue range.
February 2, acquisition announcement. The €38.5 million figure was the purchase price. MACOM expected a fiscal Q2 closing and gave no June-quarter sales estimate for OMMIC.

February 2 call, recovered third-party Q&A transcript. Asked about OMMIC’s operating scale, management estimated its then-current overall revenue run rate at roughly 1%–2% of MACOM’s total revenue. Management also discussed growing that business. Applying 2% to the later May forecast would impose a June-quarter ceiling that management never specified in this answer.
March 2 annual stockholder meeting. The March 7 filing records governance changes and voting results. I found no official recording or transcript covering other remarks at the meeting.
March 7–9 Optical Networking and Communications Conference. MACOM’s March 1 announcement identifies booth 3927 and describes live product demonstrations. It gives no consolidated Q3 sales outlook.
Conference-host archive attempt. The OFC 2023 program surfaced in search, but retrieval timed out. I could not verify a MACOM recording, full deck or transcript through the host.

May 4, fiscal Q2 release. MACOM forecast $145 million–$150 million for fiscal Q3 ending June 30 and expressly excluded all OMMIC revenue. At the high end, the combined figure would meet the threshold only if OMMIC contributed at most $13,646,050. That amount is calculated headroom, not issuer guidance.

May 4 management call. The timestamped third-party transcript includes prepared remarks and analyst Q&A. The CFO described OMMIC’s expected near-term revenue impact as immaterial in qualitative terms. The CEO repeated the OMMIC exclusion. His separate estimate of an approximately 4%–5% decline covered the full fiscal year. I found no explicit combined Q3 high end.

Official replay route specified in the earnings releases. MACOM advertised approximately 90 days of replay availability. The accessible archive listed a 2026 call and supplied no February or May 2023 host replay.
MACOM’s FY2023 financial-results archive links the quarterly releases. Its Q1 and Q2 entries yielded no separate call transcript, audio or slide deck.
Attempt to recover the issuer’s May 4 webcast link from a historical snapshot. The archive URL was inaccessible.
The separate 2023 snapshot-index request was also inaccessible. The historical event list and original webcast destination remain unverified.
May 25 intervening 8-K. Item 5.02 concerns Douglas Carlson’s retirement and gives no revised revenue figure.
May 31 closing announcement. MACOM confirmed completion of the OMMIC acquisition during Q3. It gave no contribution estimate or updated consolidated outlook.

June 13–15 International Microwave Symposium. MACOM’s June 7 release identifies product and foundry demonstrations at booths 1135 and 722, with customer questions handled by technical staff. The release gives no sales forecast.

The conference host’s program independently lists MACOM at both booths and identifies a MACOM-affiliated technical contributor. I found no host recording, transcript or MACOM financial presentation establishing a Q3 revenue ceiling. The program cannot establish what was said during live questions.
July 19 Air Force contract announcement. It describes a semiconductor development award and supplies no consolidated Q3 sales figure.
July 20 earnings notice. MACOM scheduled the August 3 release before market open. It gave no preliminary results.

August 3 actuals. The consolidated statements of operations, in thousands, show 148,522 for the three months ended June 30, 2023 and 172,259 for the three months ended July 1, 2022. The reported year-over-year decline was 13.8%.

The Q3 Form 10-Q confirms the closing date and inclusion of the acquired operation from that date. Its retrospective materiality assessment supplies no numerical ceiling that investors could have used on May 4.

publication_date_evidence: MACOM’s results release is datelined August 3, 2023 and says it announced the June-quarter results that day. The URL and upper_bound identify that verified public release and its exact GAAP revenue. August 3 is the latest possible onset date. The missing primary event record prevents establishing that it was the earliest.
